page.title: Help center
page.description: Find quick answers to frequently asked questions about Help Desk.

create-ticket.question: How can I open a new ticket?
create-ticket.answer: Go to the Tickets page, enter a title, description, category, and priority for the issue, then submit the form to create the ticket.

track-ticket.question: How can I track my ticket?
track-ticket.answer: The Tickets page shows all requests associated with your account. Select a ticket to view its details, status, assignee, history, and conversation.

ticket-number.question: What does the ticket number mean?
ticket-number.answer: The number identifies a ticket in the system. For customers, numbers are sequential within their own account, making it easier to track requests.

ticket-edit.question: Can I edit a ticket after creating it?
ticket-edit.answer: Currently, a ticket’s main details cannot be edited after creation. If you need to add information, use the conversation in the ticket details.

ticket-delete.question: Can I delete a ticket?
ticket-delete.answer: Deleting tickets is an administrative action. Customers can track their requests but cannot delete them directly.

priority.question: What do ticket priorities mean?
priority.answer: Low is for situations with little impact; Medium is for issues needing attention while work can continue; High is for issues with significant impact; and Critical is for urgent problems or situations that completely block an important activity.

change-priority.question: Can I change the priority after opening a ticket?
change-priority.answer: Priority is set when a ticket is created. If the situation changes, explain it in the ticket conversation so the support team has the latest context.

status-open.question: What does Open status mean?
status-open.answer: The ticket has been registered and is waiting for the support team to start reviewing it. Tickets released by an assignee also return to this status.

status-review.question: What does Under review mean?
status-review.answer: The support team has started evaluating the ticket. At this stage, it has no assignee and must be Under review before someone can take ownership.

status-progress.question: What does In progress mean?
status-progress.answer: An administrator or technician has taken ownership of the ticket and is working on the request.

status-resolved-closed.question: What is the difference between Resolved and Closed?
status-resolved-closed.answer: Resolved means the team considers the issue fixed. Closed is the final stage, when the ticket is permanently completed.

status-canceled.question: What does Canceled mean?
status-canceled.answer: Support for this ticket has been stopped and it will not follow the normal resolution process.

comments.question: How can I talk to the support team?
comments.answer: Open the ticket details and use the chat. New messages appear in real time to users viewing the same ticket.

assignee.question: What is a ticket assignee?
assignee.answer: The administrator or technician responsible for the request. When they take ownership of a ticket Under review, its status automatically changes to In progress.

no-assignee.question: My ticket has no assignee. Is that a problem?
no-assignee.answer: No. Tickets that are Open or Under review can remain unassigned. An assignee is set when an administrator or technician takes ownership.

release-ticket.question: What does it mean to release a ticket?
release-ticket.answer: Releasing a ticket means giving up ownership. Its status changes from In progress back to Open, it becomes unassigned, and can go through review and assignment again.

ticket-flow.question: What is the normal ticket workflow?
ticket-flow.answer: A ticket usually starts as Open. The team begins reviewing it (Under review). When a technician or administrator takes ownership, it moves to In progress. After a solution is found, it can be marked Resolved and finally Closed.

email-copy.question: Can I receive a copy of my ticket by email?
email-copy.answer: Yes. When creating a ticket, you can request an email copy containing the main details of your request.

assignment-email.question: Do technicians receive email notifications?
assignment-email.answer: Yes. When an administrator or technician takes ownership of a ticket, the system may send an email notification to the account responsible for handling it.

roles.question: What types of users exist in the system?
roles.answer: Help Desk has three main roles: Customer, Technician, and Administrator. Each role has different permissions based on its responsibilities.

customer-permissions.question: Can customers view other customers’ tickets?
customer-permissions.answer: No. Customers can only access tickets associated with their own account.

technician-permissions.question: What can a technician do?
technician-permissions.answer: Technicians can view tickets, start reviews, take ownership, and join conversations. Once assigned, only the responsible technician can change the ticket workflow; other technicians may view it but cannot control it.

admin-permissions.question: What can an administrator do?
admin-permissions.answer: Administrators can use Help Desk’s administrative features, including category management, ticket management, and reports. They can also intervene in tickets assigned to technicians when necessary.

dark-mode.question: Does the system have dark mode?
dark-mode.answer: Yes. You can change the theme in Settings or through the available interface control. Your preference is saved in the browser.
